# AQuA parity fixture

The immutable schema and synthetic probability fixture are covered in
`tests/test_analysis_aqua.py`. The upstream hard-label parity fixture remains
intentionally uncommitted until it has been generated by the exact Python 3.10
legacy environment and compared against upstream commit
`637914dcd62491766ff478dc21632813780d005d` on the A5000 host. Production
store construction fails closed while `aqua_runtime/artifacts.json` records
that parity as pending.
